description: One path an agent touched on its branch: where the file is, what happened to it, and — for a rename — where it came from. The record is a VALUE: the host composes it from its own workspace receipt (ChangedPaths) and never mutates it. Paths are compared ORDINALLY after their separators are normalised to /, so the same file reported as src/AI/Foo.cs by one agent and src\AI\Foo.cs by another is ONE row in the matrix instead of two rows that hide a real conflict. Case is kept as the host spelled it — a case-insensitive file system would also fold Foo.cs and foo.cs, but merging two genuinely distinct paths would hide a change nobody resolved. A blank Path is REJECTED at construction: a path is the matrix's row key and the reader's own side choice is keyed by it, so an invented one would move a decision onto the wrong file.

members.name: Normalize
members.description: Normalises the separators of a path the host supplied.

members.name: IsRename
members.description: Whether the agent moved the file (so PreviousPath may name where it came from).

members.name: Kind
members.description: What the agent did to the file.

members.name: Path
members.description: The path the file sits at now, with \ normalised to /.

members.name: PreviousPath
members.description: Where a renamed file came from, with its separators normalised the same way as Path. Null for every other kind, and for a rename the host did not describe.
